Class StateMachine_Predator

java.lang.Object
StateMachine
StateMachine_Predator
public class StateMachine_Predator extends StateMachine
Predator brain that prefers State.HUNTING when hungry and prey is in sight.

While hunger is below 80 and the predator is not digesting, this machine scans for the nearest valid target. Hunger below 40 widens diet to FoodPreferance.ALL. Low health still yields State.FLEEING; otherwise the predator wanders.

    • findClosestPrey

      private Organism findClosestPrey(Predator predator, List<Organism> worldEntities)
      Finds the nearest organism within visionRadius that this predator may eat.

      Other predators are skipped unless their diet is FoodPreferance.PREDATOR or FoodPreferance.ALL.

      Parameters:
      predator - the hunting predator
      worldEntities - all living organisms to scan
      Returns:
      the closest valid target, or null if none is in range
